stratagem.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagem.lore: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: ▪ Have +6" R. ▪ Have +1 S.

stratagem.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagem.lore: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks: ▪ Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. ▪ Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagem.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagem.lore: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagem.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
stratagem.lore: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.
stratagem.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
stratagem.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
